Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Akhilesh Kumar Singh,Shivendra Nath Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The present bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant in case crime No. 69/2024,
under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506, 376 Ipc and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, police station Cholapur,
District Varanasi with the prayer to enlarge the applicant on bail.

entities.text:
D.P. Act, police station Cholapur,
District
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3.  It has been argued by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant-accused is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in this case.
Applicant is brother-in-law (Jeth) of victim/informant.
The marriage of victim with brother of applicant has taken place on 07.05.2021 but there was matrimonial dispute between them.

The allegations of rape levelled against the applicant are wholly false and improbable and the same have been levelled in order to settle score in matrimonial Dinesh Singh vs State Of U.P. on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127870676/
1 dispute.

entities.text: matrimonial Dinesh Singh vs State Of U.P. on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It was submitted that in presence of other family members such an incident is not possible.

It was further submitted that victim has alleged that on the night of 13.10.2023 applicant has trespassed into her room and committed rape upon her but after the incident no complaint was made by the victim/informant.
The first information report has been lodged on 22.03.2024 making false and baseless allegations of dowry demand as well as allegations of rape against the applicant.
It was submitted that essentially the matter relates to matrimonial dispute and the allegations of rape are wholly false.

Lastly, it was submitted that the applicant is in judicial custody since 18.04.2024,
having no criminal history, and that in case applicant is enlarged on bail, the applicant will not misuse the liberty of bail.
4.
Learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the submissions of learned counsel for the parties, nature of accusations, period of custody and all attending facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits, a case for bail is made out.
Hence, the bail application is hereby allowed.

6. Let the applicant Dinesh Singh involved in the aforesaid crime be released on bail on furnishing a personal bond and two local sureties each of the like amount to the satisfaction of court concerned subject to the following conditions:
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the evidence during trial.
ii.
The applicant shall not pressurize/intimidate the prosecution witnesses.
iii. The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.
iv. The applicant shall not try to contact, threat or otherwise influence the complainant or any of the witness of the case.
7. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the court concerned shall be at liberty to cancel the bail of applicant, in accordance with law.

Order Date :- 6.6.2024 Anand  Dinesh Singh vs State Of U.P. on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/127870676/
